result.topic_en: Gauss works out the quartic (biquadratic) Gaussian periods / cyclotomic numbers for primes p = 4m+1 = 4AA+BB, giving schemes for even and odd m and quadratic and quartic relations among the periods, with numerical checks for p = 17, 41, 73.
